scope: Authorized follow-on review of the three Solar Cycle readers after the non-Solar audit and arrivals were complete.
method: Whole-corpus lexical/reference inventory and targeted contextual reading, with review of all existing definitions and first-context screening in New/Long Sun. New-note first contexts checked after integration. This is not a claim of uninterrupted close reading or exhaustive identification of every allusion.
source_policy: New sources were independently opened. Existing sources were selectively reopened for corrections, not universally recertified. Tentative identifications remain explicitly qualified.
editorial_highlights: Correct calotte from dome to clerical cap in Long Sun.
Separate ornamental pampas grass from the grassland definition using one exact guarded anchor correction.
Broaden algophilist, clerestory and agnation to their attested contextual senses.
Consolidate variant spellings and inflections under existing entries instead of duplicating notes.
Remove the low-value ordinary animal-horn definition from Short Sun.
Full popup definitions are standalone; technical and theological notes do not endorse fictional claims.
